digest.component_or_area: review kernel shared vocabulary (plan-review & code-review verifier)
propositions: Add `asserted_capability_confirmed` as an na-default graded VALIDITY sub-answer to the shared kernel `GRADED_BINARY` vocabulary with yes=finding-holds polarity (yes=1.0, insufficient=0.5, no=0.0)
The field refutes false non-delivery capability claims by confirming/refuting findings on the validity axis, not by promoting impact severity or coupling to other fields

Both plan-review and code-review Binary models must inherit the field with na default, leaving E5 byte-identical replay and E6 κ≥0.6 self-consistency unaffected outside the G6/E4/T3 asserted-capability cohort
Code-review validity/decision outputs must remain byte-identical whether the field is absent or na, enforced by regression test invariance and E5 replay artifact on 161-row corpus
IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION must NOT be bumped because the field only affects the validity axis and does NOT alter impact_code or impact_plan shape
Landing must be direct to packaged kernel (no config flag) with strict gates (E5 + E6 pass) and respect the 800-LOC module-size hard cap in verify_models.py
